scripts.postinstall: bun run frontend-i && bun run backend-i
scripts.db-up: docker start go-postgres || docker run --name go-postgres -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=1234 -e POSTGRES_DB=go_instructor -p 5432:5432 -d postgres
scripts.dev: bun db-up && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "bun backend-dev" "bun frontend-dev"
scripts.setup: bun install && bun db-up && echo '✅ Setup complete — run: bun dev'
